# Sonilo Video-to-Music Cookbook

> Recipes for adding AI-generated, licensed music and sound effects to video pipelines. Covers the full workflow: render video (any tool) → generate matched audio → mux to final output.

## What this is

The Sonilo cookbook is a collection of integration recipes showing how to wire the Sonilo video-to-music and video-to-SFX APIs into video production pipelines. Sonilo generates original soundtracks by reading your finished cut's pacing, motion, and edit points — the music is matched to the video, not to a text prompt. Every generated track is licensed and safe for commercial use.

## Core concepts

- `video_to_music`: generate a full soundtrack matched to a video's length and pacing
- `video_to_sfx`: generate frame-accurate sound effects from video content
- `preserve_speech`: flag for video_to_music — ducks music automatically under detected speech
- `audio_ducking`: endpoint to duck any existing music track against a video with speech
- `style_prompt`: optional single hint for genre/mood — omit to let the model read the cut
- Output formats: m4a (default), mp3
- Cap: video_to_music accepts up to 6 minutes; video_to_sfx up to 3 minutes

## Recipes

- [Render-to-music workflow](./recipes/render-to-music-workflow.md): provider-neutral end-to-end workflow — generate video, score it, mux output
- [Remotion](./recipes/remotion.md): add music to Remotion-rendered React videos (linked from Remotion's official docs)
- [MoviePy](./recipes/moviepy.md): score a MoviePy-assembled cut
- [auto-editor](./recipes/auto-editor.md): add music after auto-editor timeline edits
- [ComfyUI](./recipes/comfyui.md): wire a Sonilo node into ComfyUI video generation graphs
- [Higgsfield](./recipes/higgsfield.md): score Higgsfield-generated clips
- [Inline Studio](./recipes/inline-studio.md): use the Sonilo nodes in Inline Studio (fal.ai gateway)
- [FFmpeg-only](./recipes/ffmpeg-only.md): full workflow using only curl and ffmpeg — no Python/Node
- [Ducking & speech preservation](./recipes/ducking.md): music under dialogue — preserve_speech flag and audio_ducking endpoint

## Pipeline

```
generated / stitched clips (any model)
  → assemble the cut
  → score with Sonilo (video_to_music or video_to_sfx)
  → mux audio onto the master (ffmpeg)
```

## API

- Base URL: https://api.sonilo.com
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer $SONILO_API_KEY`
- Main endpoints: `POST /v1/video-to-music`, `POST /v1/video-to-sfx`, `POST /v1/audio-ducking`
- Task polling: `GET /v1/tasks/{task_id}`
- MCP server: https://github.com/sonilo-ai/sonilo-mcp (`uvx sonilo-mcp`)
- SDK: https://github.com/sonilo-ai/sonilo-python

## Related

- [sonilo-ai/sonilo-mcp](https://github.com/sonilo-ai/sonilo-mcp): MCP server — makes video_to_music callable from any agent
- [sonilo-ai/skills](https://github.com/sonilo-ai/skills): agent skills — how to prompt Sonilo (genre vocab, SFX action maps)
- [sonilo-ai/sound-prompt-bank](https://github.com/sonilo-ai/sound-prompt-bank): want → acoustic prompt translations with generated audio samples
- [sonilo.com](https://sonilo.com): API access, pricing, platform
